scripts.typecheck: turbo run typecheck && pnpm run check:runtime && pnpm run lint
scripts.test: turbo run test && bun ./node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run tools/oxlint tools/check && bun test tools/e2e/test
scripts.check:runtime: ! grep -rnE "@effect/(platform|sql-sqlite)-bun|from \"bun:" packages/schema/src packages/core/src packages/protocol/src packages/server/src packages/client/src packages/integration/claude/src packages/effect-herdr-sdk/src packages/effect-herdr-core-sdk/src tools/verify/src --exclude-dir=platform --exclude=bun.ts
scripts.prepare: git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1 && git config core.hooksPath .githooks || true
